newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy recovering, job situation severe-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy recovering, job situation severe-MOF.

text.p: Japan's economy is gradually recovering, but the employment situation remains severe despite some improvements, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Wednesday.
Production activity is increasing moderately with corporate earnings showing improvement, the ministry said in a summary of reports submitted by its regional officies.

"The economy is continuing to recover gradually. The job situation has shown improvements, but it still remains severe," it said. Managers of the regional bureaus are meeting at MOF headquarters to discuss the economic situation in their areas.
It said private consumption and capital investment, the two main engines of growth, are on a gradual recovery track.
Public works spending and housing construction remain at a high level, it added.
